name: Checkbox
description: A checkbox input component that renders a real <input type="checkbox"> for accessibility, with a custom-styled visual overlay. Supports checked, indeterminate, disabled, and error states.

notes: A real <input type="checkbox"> is rendered and visually hidden; the styled box is a presentation layer.
The indeterminate state is set via the indeterminate DOM property and aria-checked="mixed".
Focus indicator appears on the visual checkbox via :focus-visible using var(--color-border-focus).
When isError is true, the border uses var(--color-border-danger).
The label is associated with the input via htmlFor/id pairing.
Touch target is at minimum 44×44px via min-block-size and min-inline-size on the wrapper.

indeterminate.description: Whether the checkbox is in an indeterminate state. Overrides checked visually. Sets aria-checked to 'mixed'.

disabled.description: Disables the checkbox. Prevents interaction and reduces visual emphasis.

isError.description: Shows an error state. Border colour changes to var(--color-border-danger).

onChange.description: Called when the checked state changes.

children.description: Label content rendered next to the checkbox.

labelPlacement.description: Position of the label relative to the checkbox visual. 'end' places the label after the checkbox (inline-end); 'start' places it before; 'top' places it above; 'bottom' places it below.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the wrapper element.

do: Always provide visible label text as children, or an aria-label if no children.
Use indeterminate for parent checkboxes in a tree/group that are partially selected.
Use isError alongside a visible error message to communicate validation failures.
Group multiple checkboxes inside a CheckboxGroup with a legend.
dont: Do not use indeterminate as a substitute for an unchecked state.
Do not leave a checkbox without an associated label.
Do not use for mutually exclusive choices — use RadioGroup instead.
